notes: Vendor-published model-card evaluation tables. Gemini 3.8 Flash table results are dated September 2026 and do not label effort. Gemini 3.1 Pro remains Preview; its card table labels the effort as “Thinking (High)”. Vendor-published comparisons are marked comparable:false and use separate comparability groups from third-party board readings. Numeric values retain the displayed precision; percentages are normalized to 0–1 per catalog convention.

claims.statement: Google DeepMind’s September 2026 model card publishes an evaluation table for Gemini 3.8 Flash across coding, knowledge work, multimodal, long-context, computer-use, and scientific-reasoning benchmarks.
Google DeepMind’s February 2026 model card identifies Gemini 3.1 Pro as a preview and publishes results for its Thinking (High) configuration.
